data.exact_reserve_text: Gross basis as at 31 December 2016 claims development table on page 22 shows cumulative incurred claims by underwriting year.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 38.4 million in 2016, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This adverse development was primarily driven by prior years in the Political Risks and Consumer Products classes, including higher than expected attritional development in legacy European Creditor business, large notifications in the Political Risks class, and an unfavourable development in a legacy Property claim.

unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 22, excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2016). The narrative on page 21 mentions a 'deterioration of GBP 10.9m' to claims reserves, which is likely a net figure and differs from the gross triangle calculation.
